name: Valencia Town Center
description: Westfield Valencia Town Center is a relaxed shopping mall in Valencia featuring national retailers, local eateries, family-friendly playgrounds, and an Edwards IMAX theater for entertainment. The center offers a comprehensive shopping and dining experience with extended hours and seasonal events including Photos with Santa and holiday performances.
demographics: Valencia Town Center serves the affluent Santa Clarita Valley community, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle-class families with median household incomes ranging from $90,000 to $120,000. The trade area demographic skews toward families with children, young professionals aged 25-54, and retirees who appreciate the center's family-friendly amenities and convenient access from the I-5 corridor. Typical visitors are lifestyle-oriented shoppers seeking a mix of national retailers, casual dining, and entertainment options in a comfortable, suburban mall environment.
